title: Colliders: per-bucket diff rebuilds, budgeted urgent builds, no rebuild on liquid- or light-only remeshes
player_outcome: Mining, placing torches, flowing water and walking into new ground no longer hitch while physics shapes rebuild. The ground under the player is always solid.
design: Checked in code: ColliderManager.SetData marks Dirty on every remesh (ColliderManager.cs:43-48), including liquid steps and light-only remeshes. Chunks at Chebyshev distance ≤ 1 rebuild outside any budget (:75-77): up to 27 chunks × 8 ConcavePolygonShape3D Jolt BVH builds on main. WorldEditor.Objects.DirtyForLight (Relight and torches) urgently dirties the 8 chunks within 16 cells.

Core: add CollisionBuilder.ComputeHashes() → ulong[16] (8 solid and 8 platform buckets; Hash.Combine over triangle float bits and counts). ChunkMesher.Build calls it on the worker and stores the result on ChunkMeshResult.Collision.

Rewrite ColliderManager with one static body per non-empty bucket (up to 16 per chunk) instead of one body with 8 shapes. SetData(coord, data) returns ColliderChange {Unchanged, Pending, Stored} by diffing hashes into DirtyMask; Unchanged does no work at all.

UpdateFocus(focus, budgetMs) frees far bodies, then builds in this order: (a) the focus chunk and never-built chunks at Chebyshev ≤ 1, immediately; (b) chunks passed to Prioritize(IEnumerable<Int3>) (player edits); (c) the rest nearest-first while elapsed < budget. Old bucket bodies stay until replaced, so there are never holes.

ColliderManager API: BodyBuilt fires only when some bucket's geometry changed. Add IsPending(coord); HasBody(coord) uses a chunk-level Built flag; BodyCount counts chunks with bodies (same meaning for the colliders.bodies probe); counters Rebuilt and Skipped. Time it as gd.colliders.build.

Shapes: create them with PhysicsServer3D.ConcavePolygonShapeCreate() + ShapeSetData(dict {faces = Variant.CreateFrom(span), backface_collision = true}) to skip the Vector3[] copy. Fall back to MeshUpload.Faces if the span API is unavailable.
WorldRuntime: MeshReady passes the change result; subscribe game.Editor.ChunksDirty to _colliders.Prioritize; pass Budgets.CollidersMs.

Light-only dirtying: DirtyForLight raises urgent ChunksDirty only for the light's own chunk, and a new non-urgent LightDirty event for the other up to 7 chunks. GameWorld wires Editor.LightDirty to Streamer.MarkDirty(d, urgent: false).
Probes in GodotCommandHost: colliders.rebuilt, colliders.skipped, colliders.pending.
files_modify: game/World/ColliderManager.cs — per-bucket bodies, diff, budget order, Prioritize, counters
game/World/WorldRuntime.cs — change handling, Prioritize wiring, budget
src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.cs — wire LightDirty to non-urgent remesh
tests: CollisionHashTests.LiquidOnlyChangeKeepsHashes: remesh after setting a liquid cell gives identical 16 hashes (the liquid surface differs)
CollisionHashTests.LightSourceKeepsHashes: meshing with an added LightSource gives identical hashes
CollisionHashTests.MiningChangesOnlyNearbyBuckets: removing one cell changes at most its bucket and face-adjacent buckets
CollisionHashTests.Deterministic: same input gives the same hashes
liquids.cmds: after pouring water and `wait 3`, `assert colliders.skipped > 0`
perf.cmds: `mark` a probe before torch placement, then `assert colliders.rebuilt` increases by ≤ 2 after 10 torches; basic.cmds still has `assert colliders.bodies > 0`
verification: dotnet test; smoke movement.cmds, liquids.cmds, basic.cmds, builder.cmds (player.on_floor after mining and building near chunk borders)
Rendering perf run: perf.max.gd.colliders well below baseline; no gd.colliders entries in `perf spikes` while placing torches or during water flow
risks: Jolt with many small static bodies (≤16 × 125 near the player): verify broadphase cost in F3
A bucket collider outside the focus chunk can be stale for a few frames: edits are prioritized to limit this
ObjectPlacement.Ground raycasts use TerrainLayer: keep the same layers
